assessments.reasoning: On exit from an identified drop scope, later-declared variables drop before earlier-declared variables, and later-created temporaries drop before earlier-created temporaries. Applying the rule requires first determining scope membership.

challenge.method: Check whether the ordering implies that all temporaries in a block survive until block exit or that a moved value drops again.
challenge.results: The passage orders drops associated with the scope being exited. Expression-specific scope boundaries can produce earlier drops, and the adjacent partial-move example limits destruction to the remaining initialized field.

limitations: This applies within the drop scope. Edition, control flow, expression kind, and special scrutinee rules matter when determining a temporary's scope.
